title: The Impact of Derivatives on Spot Markets: Evidence from the Introduction of Bitcoin Futures Contracts
eligible_reason: Single-event DiD: Treatment = BTC-USD exchange pairs (vs other fiat-currency BTC pairs), Post = month >= 201801 after the December 2017 CBOE/CME bitcoin futures launch, Treatment_Post with exchange-pair, month and currency-pair FE (and triple differences with short-selling, arbitrage-risk, capital-control and attention indicators). The ETH analysis (Tables 9, 11) is another single-date event. One adoption date per design, so not staggered.
